title: A Future Untold
direction: Map musical phrases to broad rain gestures: one larger soft impact can mark a phrase entrance, followed by sparse smaller echoes. Do not chase individual notes.

sections.name: echo: opening
sections.note: Frequent measured phrase notes are followed by smaller physical echoes tied to separate attacks. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
